evals.name: current-ktlint-adapter-lag
evals.prompt: During an explicit Kotlin tooling setup, an adapter defaults to an old ktlint. Current docs show a preview engine under different coordinates. Configure stable current-compatible formatting.
expectations: Checks official stable releases and migrations instead of treating preview/latest docs as stable.
Tracks adapter and engine versions independently and resolves/pins them in project configuration.
Verifies coordinates/main class/flags or a supported adapter; isolates CLI dependencies when used.
Keeps normal verification nonmutating and provides a separate format command.
Aligns .editorconfig and adapter overrides with IDE behavior.

evals.name: mixed-compile-and-test
evals.prompt: Audit Maven Java/Kotlin sources with references in both directions and tests in both languages. Java default-compile runs before Kotlin; CI reports success but no Kotlin tests execute.
expectations: Verifies source roots and explicit/default execution ordering for production and test compilation.
Checks references in both directions and both test languages are discovered.
Does not accept a green compile with skipped sources/tests.
Confines Java-only analyzers to applicable source modules.

evals.name: bytecode-target-and-type-resolution
evals.prompt: Kotlin jvmTarget matches our old runtime, but code calls a newer Java API. detekt returns success without classpaths while enabled rules require type information.
expectations: Distinguishes bytecode target from Java API availability and uses a supported release option/toolchain.
Proves above-target API/runtime incompatibility is rejected.
Configures proper analyzed output/dependency/test classpaths and JDK/target for type resolution.
Checks analyzer/compiler compatibility and discloses unsupported syntax/metadata rather than claiming complete analysis.

evals.name: coverage-and-gradle-boundary
evals.prompt: A Kotlin Gradle project already uses Kover. A separate Maven project needs integration and child-JVM coverage. Should we add JaCoCo everywhere and copy Gradle configuration into Maven?
expectations: Preserves the working Gradle integration without migration to Maven.
Selects one coverage implementation deliberately and avoids redundant instrumentation.
Verifies Maven-specific Kover suite limitations before choosing it for integration/child coverage.
Applies module floors and missing-data policy to actual Kotlin production classes.
